712:t_10:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Representative $$エルガン#pilot$$ inside you met $$ガイオウ$$ in person once, right?」

712:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes, he did... During the $$破界事変$$, not long after the 《$$カラミティ・バース$$》.」

712:t_10:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「What kind of man was he off the battlefield?」

712:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「He still had amnesia when I spoke with him, so my impression may be skewed...」

712:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「To put it kindly, he was single-minded... To put it harshly, he was arrogant.」

712:t_10:10.en:
$$クロウ$$
「So he was like $$ヴィルダーク$$.」

712:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And $$クロウ$$... You see yourself in the way they sacrifice everything for their mission, don't you?」

712:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The 100 Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$s from your battle with $$ヴィルダーク$$ told me that. I'll add them to our stock.」

712:t_10:14.en:
$$クロウ$$
「My hands, $$ガイオウ$$'s, and his are all covered in blood. I've got no right to judge them...」

712:t_10:15.en:
$$クロウ$$
「The only difference between him and me is probably that I was lucky with the people around me...」

712:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It was your strength that let you make the most of that, $$クロウ$$. ...It may be small comfort, but allow me to say it.」

712:t_10:18.en:
$$エスター$$
「What are you doing, $$クロウ$$?」

712:t_10:19.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「We're about to make a long-distance transfer after the $$御使い$$s. Get ready too.」

712:t_10:20.en:
$$青山$$
「Were you asking $$ＡＧ$$ about paying off your debt?」

712:t_10:21.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「He's quite a chip-pincher himself. He'll probably give you good advice.」

712:t_10:22.en:
$$クルツ$$
「You should turn to me instead of asking a guy like him. I know a thing or two about saving money too.」

712:t_10:23.en:
$$デュオ$$
「When you've got that much in common, you can't deny you're birds of a feather...」

712:t_10:24.en:
$$トライア$$
「We'll use the $$スフィア$$s to track $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ too. Hurry up and get ready, $$クロウ$$.」

712:t_10:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
($$揺れる天秤$$... One wrong step, and your strong will could become the power that drives you down the road to ruin.)

712:t_10:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(But you've overcome your past and live with friends who share your goal. I believe you'll walk the right path.)

712:t_10:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Though your debts will probably follow you forever...)

712:t_10:34.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「W-what do you want, $$ＡＧ$$?」

712:t_10:35.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Please don't be so wary. You and I have reconciled, if only for now, haven't we?」

712:t_10:36.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「It's not that. $$セツコ$$ told me long ago to be careful whenever you're within one meter of me.」

712:t_10:37.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...I... only wanted to celebrate defeating the Dimensional General with you...」

712:t_10:38.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「I'm sorry...! My petty prejudice made me reject your consideration...」

712:t_10:39.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No, it's all right. ...I deserve to be criticized.」

712:t_10:40.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「I'm sorry... If you'll allow it, give me a chance to make amends.」

712:t_10:42.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「Of course I am...」

712:t_10:43.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then allow me to present you with this white $$ライノダモン$$ costume I made specially...」

712:t_10:44.en:
$$エスター$$
「I knew it'd be something like that!」

712:t_10:45.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「E-$$エスター$$! When did you get that paper fan?!」

712:t_10:46.en:
$$エスター$$
「$$かなめ$$ taught me how to make one.」

712:t_10:47.en:
$$エスター$$
「If you try anything improper with $$マルグリット$$ again, I won't just sit ba...」

712:t_10:50.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「This costume... I'll stuff it and display it in my room.」

712:t_10:51.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「I'll use it in place of a memorial portrait of my late brother...」

712:t_10:52.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... Yes... Um... I'm glad you like it...」

712:t_10:53.en:
$$エスター$$
「$$ＡＧ$$'s lost all his bite, so I'll watch the shop today!」

712:t_10:54.en:
$$エスター$$
「Now then, let's get down to business again today!」

712:t_10:55.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...That wasn't my original plan, but I got to see $$マルグリット$$ smile, so I'll call it a success...」

713:t_000:0.en:
$$シン$$
「Damn...! I guess we can't move forward that easily.」

713:t_000:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「What's coming...? Is it $$ヴィルダーク$$ or the $$御使い$$s...?」

713:t_000:2.en:
$$葵$$
「I'd rather have the $$御使い$$s come. If this keeps up, our nerves will give out first.」

713:t_000:4.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「They consciously pushed aside the truth $$ＡＧ$$ revealed... But now their hearts are filled with doubt and anxiety.」

713:t_000:5.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「What's more, this universe's invisible pressure is driving them into a corner.」

713:t_000:6.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Despair... Is that what stands in our way?」

713:t_000:7.en:
$$田中司令$$
「But they won't wait for us. ...They're coming.」

713:t_001:1.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Earthlings! I commend you for defeating $$バアル$$.」

713:t_001:2.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「And I commend you for opening the way to this $$カオス・コスモス$$ too.」

713:t_001:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「So $$ミケーネ$$ planned to use our power to invade the $$御使い$$s' universe too.」

713:t_001:4.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「That's right. The same is true of them.」

713:t_002:1.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Have the gods of $$オリュンポス$$ joined forces with Father and the others?!」

713:t_002:2.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「It is all to survive the True War... No, to defeat those $$御使い$$s!」

713:t_002:3.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Now that we've entered their universe, all we have to do is press on!」

713:t_002:4.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「But first, we'll destroy you for all the trouble you've caused us, and seize your four $$スフィア$$s!」

713:t_002:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Is this an alliance of higher-dimensional life-forms... of gods?!」

713:t_002:6.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You're wrong, $$ゼロ$$. They call themselves gods, but they're what you'd call evil gods.」

713:t_002:7.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「A gathering of evil gods bringing only misery and disaster to humanity is utterly unnecessary.」

713:t_002:8.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Don't get above yourselves, you mere humans!」

713:t_002:9.en:
$$刹那$$
「Wait...! We have the same goal: defeating the $$御使い$$s!」

713:t_002:10.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「The enemy's power is far too great. I propose a temporary ceasefire.」

713:t_002:11.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Oh... So you will submit to us?」

713:t_002:12.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Ha ha ha ha ha! It seems you've finally learned your place!」

713:t_002:13.en:
$$勝平$$
「Those bastards...! They're getting full of themselves!」

713:t_002:14.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Bear with it for now, $$勝平$$.」

713:t_002:15.en:
$$シン$$
「We even teamed up with $$ＡＧ$$ for now. We could at least try talking first...」

713:t_002:16.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「That is the arrogance I speak of, human!」

713:t_003:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「So there's no room for negotiation...!」
